tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description:
Vocabulary map of the corpus: obligation clusters (with support status),
    regulation terms, everyday-phrase bridges, concept bridges (recurring
    legal phrases the corpus uses but never defines — "public interest",
    "high risk" — routed to their operative clusters), and corpus boundaries

tools.name: retrieve_evidence
tools.description:
Evidence packets for legal topics. Selectors (union): cluster ids
    and/or term keys from get_catalog, and/or free_text (deterministic
    lexical+bridge matching only — no semantic search). Each packet returns
    primary rules PLUS their preconditions and exceptions with byte-exact
    quotes an

tools.name: validate_claims
tools.description:
Verify a drafted answer's legal citations before presenting it.
    Each claim: {claim_id, assertion, cluster_id, claim_type, claim_concept,
    citations: [{rule_id, quote}]}. ALWAYS supply cluster_id for legal
    propositions — v0.3.8: WITHOUT it a claim cannot be grounded at all
    (verdict unc
